{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue to float after removing commas
# First, confirm all revenue values have commas and are in the expected format
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check if the conversion worked
print(df['revenue_clean'].head())

# Also check for 999999.99 sentinel values
sentinel_count = (df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99).sum()
print(f'Number of rows with revenue = 999999.99: {sentinel_count}')"}
